description: Deterministic local-only daily cutoff, gradual materialization, detail amplification, and retry backlog workload. No third-party network access.
correctness_gates: expected Source count equals frozen occurrence count
every occurrence is materialized exactly once
listing and detail Work counts exactly match the workload
due times remain inside the frozen window and avoid a two-times-mean hourly hotspot
capacity projection is exact only while each runnable status stays within its 5000-row scan bound and is explicitly truncated otherwise
